# DMARC Report Analytics

**Workbook release:** v1.5.0 · **GitHub:** [pthoor/DMARC-for-Defender-XDR](https://github.com/pthoor/DMARC-for-Defender-XDR) · **Latest release:** [Check releases](https://github.com/pthoor/DMARC-for-Defender-XDR/releases/latest)

> **Update check:** If the latest GitHub release is newer than the version above, import the updated `workbook/dmarc-workbook.json`.

Monitor email authentication health, detect spoofing, track compliance scores, analyze senders, and plan DMARC policy enforcement across your domains. Filter by workspace, time range, domain, and reporter.

DMARC aggregate reports usually arrive 24–48 hours after the mail was sent, so the most recent day is often incomplete. Panels with a fixed window in their title (for example *Last 24h* or *Last 30 Days*) don't follow the Time Range picker.

content.json: High-level overview of your DMARC posture across all monitored domains. Track pass rates, enforcement progress, message volumes, and identify priority actions to improve email authentication.

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend MessageCountSafe = tolong(coalesce(MessageCount, 0))
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
;
let stats = data
| summarize
    TotalMessages = sum(MessageCountSafe),
    Pass = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == true),
    Fail = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == false),
    DomainsMonitored = dcountif(Domain, isnotempty(Domain)),
    UniqueIPs = dcountif(SourceIP, isnotempty(SourceIP)),
    UniqueReporters = dcountif(ReportOrgName, isnotempty(ReportOrgName));
let policyStats = data
| where isnotempty(Domain)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PolicyPublished_p) by Domain
| summarize
    EnforcedDomains = countif(PolicyPublished_p in ('quarantine', 'reject')),
    TotalDomains = count();
let combined = stats
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=leftouter (policyStats | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| project-away JoinKey, JoinKey1
| extend
    PassRate = iff(TotalMessages > 0, round(100.0 * Pass / TotalMessages, 1), 0.0),
    EnforcementPct = iff(TotalDomains > 0, round(100.0 * EnforcedDomains / TotalDomains, 1), 0.0);
combined | project Metric = 'Total Messages', Value = toreal(TotalMessages), Order = 1
| union (combined | project Metric = 'DMARC Pass Rate %', Value = PassRate, Order = 2)
| union (combined | project Metric = 'Domains Monitored', Value = toreal(DomainsMonitored), Order = 3)
| union (combined | project Metric = 'Enforcement %', Value = EnforcementPct, Order = 4)
| union (combined | project Metric = 'Unique Source IPs', Value = toreal(UniqueIPs), Order = 5)
| union (combined | project Metric = 'Unique Reporters', Value = toreal(UniqueReporters), Order = 6)
| sort by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Key Metrics

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let thisWeek = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend MessageCountSafe = tolong(coalesce(MessageCount, 0))| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| summarize
    TW_Messages = sum(MessageCountSafe),
    TW_Pass = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == true),
    TW_Fail = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == false),
    TW_UniqueIPs = dcountif(SourceIP, isnotempty(SourceIP));
let lastWeek = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(7d))
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend MessageCountSafe = tolong(coalesce(MessageCount, 0))| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| summarize
    LW_Messages = sum(MessageCountSafe),
    LW_Pass = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == true),
    LW_Fail = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == false),
    LW_UniqueIPs = dcountif(SourceIP, isnotempty(SourceIP));
let combined = thisWeek
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=leftouter (lastWeek | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| project-away JoinKey, JoinKey1
| extend
    TW_Messages = tolong(coalesce(TW_Messages, 0)),
    LW_Messages = tolong(coalesce(LW_Messages, 0)),
    TW_Fail = tolong(coalesce(TW_Fail, 0)),
    LW_Fail = tolong(coalesce(LW_Fail, 0)),
    TW_UniqueIPs = tolong(coalesce(TW_UniqueIPs, 0)),
    LW_UniqueIPs = tolong(coalesce(LW_UniqueIPs, 0))
| extend
    TW_PassRate = iff(TW_Messages > 0, round(100.0 * TW_Pass / TW_Messages, 1), 0.0),
    LW_PassRate = iff(LW_Messages > 0, round(100.0 * LW_Pass / LW_Messages, 1), 0.0),
    HasPrior = LW_Messages > 0
| extend
    PassRateChange = round(TW_PassRate - LW_PassRate, 1),
    MsgChange = iff(HasPrior, round(100.0 * (TW_Messages - LW_Messages) / LW_Messages, 1), 0.0),
    FailChange = TW_Fail - LW_Fail,
    IPChange = TW_UniqueIPs - LW_UniqueIPs;
union
    (combined | project Metric = 'DMARC Pass Rate', Value = strcat(TW_PassRate, '%'), Change = iff(HasPrior, strcat(iff(PassRateChange >= 0, '+', ''), PassRateChange, ' pts vs previous week'), 'No data for previous week'), Order = 1),
    (combined | project Metric = 'Messages', Value = tostring(TW_Messages), Change = iff(HasPrior, strcat(iff(MsgChange >= 0, '+', ''), MsgChange, '% vs previous week'), 'No data for previous week'), Order = 2),
    (combined | project Metric = 'Failed Messages', Value = tostring(TW_Fail), Change = iff(HasPrior, strcat(iff(FailChange >= 0, '+', ''), FailChange, ' vs previous week'), 'No data for previous week'), Order = 3),
    (combined | project Metric = 'Unique Source IPs', Value = tostring(TW_UniqueIPs), Change = iff(HasPrior, strcat(iff(IPChange >= 0, '+', ''), IPChange, ' vs previous week'), 'No data for previous week'), Order = 4)
| sort by Order asc
| project Metric, Value, Change
content.title: Week-over-Week Comparison (Last 7 Days vs Previous 7 Days)

content.json:
### Understanding Pass Rates
**DMARC Pass Rate** = percentage of messages where **either SPF or DKIM passes** (logical OR). This is the metric that determines whether a message is compliant with your DMARC policy.

**SPF Pass Rate** and **DKIM Pass Rate** are measured independently. It is normal for SPF to be lower than DMARC — forwarded emails and third-party senders often break SPF alignment while DKIM signatures remain valid. A high DMARC pass rate with a lower SPF rate simply means DKIM is doing the heavy lifting.

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
;
data
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| summarize
    DmarcPass = sumif(MessageCount, DmarcPassEffective == true),
    SpfPass = sumif(MessageCount, PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass'),
    DkimPass = sumif(MessageCount, PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass'),
    Total = sum(MessageCount)
    by bin(ReportDateRangeBegin, 1d)
| extend
    DmarcPassRate = iff(Total > 0, round(100.0 * DmarcPass / Total, 1), 0.0),
    SpfPassRate = iff(Total > 0, round(100.0 * SpfPass / Total, 1), 0.0),
    DkimPassRate = iff(Total > 0, round(100.0 * DkimPass / Total, 1), 0.0)
| project TimeGenerated = ReportDateRangeBegin, DmarcPassRate, SpfPassRate, DkimPassRate
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
### Compliance Score & Risk Level
The **Compliance Score** (0–100) reflects overall DMARC deployment maturity per domain, not just the pass rate. It is a weighted composite:

| Component | Weight | Description |
|---|---|---|
| DMARC Pass Rate | 40% | Messages passing DMARC (SPF or DKIM) |
| SPF Pass Rate | 25% | Messages with aligned SPF |
| DKIM Pass Rate | 25% | Messages with aligned DKIM |
| Policy Enforcement | 10% | `p=reject` = 100, `p=quarantine` = 60, `p=none` = 20 |

**Why can the score be lower than the pass rate?** A domain with 99% DMARC pass rate but low SPF alignment and `p=none` policy will score lower because it lacks defense-in-depth (both SPF and DKIM) and is not yet enforcing its policy.

**Risk Levels:** Low (90+) · Moderate (70–89) · High (50–69) · Critical (<50)

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend MessageCountSafe = tolong(coalesce(MessageCount, 0))
;
let policies = data
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PolicyPublished_p) by Domain
| project Domain, PolicyPublished_p;
data
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| summarize
    Messages = sum(MessageCountSafe),
    DmarcPass = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == true),
    SpfPassCount = sumif(MessageCountSafe, PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass'),
    DkimPassCount = sumif(MessageCountSafe, PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass')
    by Domain
| join kind=leftouter policies on Domain
| extend
    PassRate = iff(Messages > 0, round(100.0 * DmarcPass / Messages, 1), 0.0),
    ComplianceScore = iff(
        Messages > 0,
        round(
            0.40 * (100.0 * DmarcPass / Messages)
            + 0.25 * (100.0 * SpfPassCount / Messages)
            + 0.25 * (100.0 * DkimPassCount / Messages)
            + 0.10 * case(PolicyPublished_p == 'reject', 100.0, PolicyPublished_p == 'quarantine', 60.0, PolicyPublished_p == 'none', 20.0, 0.0)
        , 0),
        0.0
    )
| extend
    RiskLevel = case(
        ComplianceScore >= 90, 'Low',
        ComplianceScore >= 70, 'Moderate',
        ComplianceScore >= 50, 'High',
        'Critical'
    )
| project Domain, ComplianceScore, RiskLevel, PassRate, Policy=PolicyPublished_p, Messages
| sort by ComplianceScore asc
content.title: Per-Domain Risk Level

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
;
let domainIssues = data
| summarize
    Messages = sum(MessageCount),
    FailedMessages = sumif(MessageCount, DmarcPassEffective == false),
    arg_max(TimeGenerated, PolicyPublished_p)
    by Domain
| extend PassRate = iff(Messages > 0, round(100.0 * (Messages - FailedMessages) / Messages, 1), 0.0)
| extend Issue = case(
    PolicyPublished_p == 'none' and PassRate >= 97, strcat('Domain "', Domain, '" is ready for p=quarantine (', PassRate, '% pass rate) - move from monitor mode'),
    PolicyPublished_p == 'quarantine' and PassRate >= 99, strcat('Domain "', Domain, '" is ready for p=reject (', PassRate, '% pass rate) - strengthen enforcement'),
    PassRate < 80, strcat('Domain "', Domain, '" has critical auth failures (', PassRate, '% pass rate, ', FailedMessages, ' failures) - investigate sources'),
    PassRate < 95, strcat('Domain "', Domain, '" has auth issues (', PassRate, '% pass rate) - review failing senders'),
    ''
)
| where isnotempty(Issue);
let ipIssues = data
| where DmarcPassEffective == false
| where not(PolicyEvaluated_reason_type has_any ('forwarded', 'trusted_forwarder', 'mailing_list'))
| summarize FailedMessages = sum(MessageCount), Domains = make_set(Domain, 3), SpfDomains = make_set(SpfDomain, 1) by SourceIP
| where FailedMessages >= 10
| extend SpfDomain = tostring(SpfDomains[0])
| extend KnownService = case(
    SpfDomain has 'spf.protection.outlook.com', 'Microsoft 365',
    SpfDomain has '_spf.google.com', 'Google Workspace',
    SpfDomain has 'amazonses.com', 'Amazon SES',
    SpfDomain has 'sendgrid.net', 'SendGrid',
    SpfDomain has 'servers.mcsv.net', 'Mailchimp',
    SpfDomain has 'mandrillapp.com', 'Mandrill',
    SpfDomain has 'mailgun.org', 'Mailgun',
    SpfDomain has 'spf.mtasv.net', 'Postmark',
    SpfDomain has '_spf.sparkpostmail.com', 'SparkPost',
    SpfDomain has '_spf.salesforce.com', 'Salesforce',
    SpfDomain has 'service-now.com', 'ServiceNow',
    SpfDomain has 'mail.zendesk.com', 'Zendesk',
    SpfDomain has 'email.freshdesk.com', 'Freshdesk',
    SpfDomain has 'spf.constantcontact.com', 'Constant Contact',
    SpfDomain has 'sendinblue.com', 'Brevo',
    SpfDomain has 'cmail1.com', 'Campaign Monitor',
    SpfDomain has 'pphosted.com', 'Proofpoint',
    SpfDomain has '_netblocks.mimecast.com', 'Mimecast',
    SpfDomain has 'zoho.com', 'Zoho Mail',
    SpfDomain has 'marketing.dynamics.com', 'Dynamics 365 Marketing',
    SpfDomain has 'hubspotemail.net', 'HubSpot',
    'Unknown'
)
| extend ServiceName = iff(KnownService == 'Unknown' and isnotempty(SpfDomain), SpfDomain, KnownService)
| extend GeoInfo = geo_info_from_ip_address(SourceIP)
| extend Country = tostring(GeoInfo.country)
| extend
    IssuePriority = iff(KnownService == 'Unknown', 1, 2),
    IssueCategory = iff(KnownService == 'Unknown', 'Suspicious Activity', 'Sender Configuration'),
    Issue = iff(KnownService == 'Unknown',
        strcat('Unrecognized IP ', SourceIP, ' (', iff(isempty(SpfDomain), 'no SPF domain', SpfDomain), ', ', Country, ') sent ', FailedMessages, ' failing messages for ', strcat_array(Domains, ', '), ' - possible spoofing; do not authorize it unless you recognize the sender'),
        strcat(KnownService, ' IP ', SourceIP, ' (', Country, ') sent ', FailedMessages, ' failing messages for ', strcat_array(Domains, ', '), ' - if this is your service, set up DKIM signing with your domain; otherwise it may be another customer of the same platform'))
| top 5 by FailedMessages desc;
let policyIssues = data
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PolicyPublished_p) by Domain
| where PolicyPublished_p == 'none'
| summarize Domains = make_list(Domain)
| where array_length(Domains) > 0
| extend Issue = strcat(array_length(Domains), ' domain(s) still in monitor mode (p=none): ', strcat_array(Domains, ', '));
union
    (domainIssues | project Priority = case(Issue has 'critical', 1, Issue has 'ready for p=reject', 2, Issue has 'ready for p=quarantine', 3, 4), Category = 'Domain Health', Issue),
    (ipIssues | project Priority = IssuePriority, Category = IssueCategory, Issue),
    (policyIssues | project Priority = 3, Category = 'Policy Progression', Issue)
| sort by Priority asc
| take 15
| project Priority = case(Priority == 1, 'Critical', Priority == 2, 'High', Priority == 3, 'Medium', 'Low'), Category, ActionItem = Issue

content.query:

| extend MessageCountSafe = tolong(coalesce(MessageCount, 0))
;
let total = toscalar(data | summarize TotalMessages = sum(MessageCountSafe));
data
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| extend
    SPF_Status = iff(PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass', 'SPF Pass', 'SPF Fail'),

| summarize Messages = sum(MessageCountSafe), AnyDmarcPass = maxif(1, DmarcPassEffective == true) by SPF_Status, DKIM_Status
| extend
    DMARC_Result = iff(AnyDmarcPass == 1, 'DMARC Pass', 'DMARC Fail'),
    Percentage = iff(total > 0, round(100.0 * Messages / total, 1), 0.0)
| project SPF_Status, DKIM_Status, DMARC_Result, Messages, Percentage
| sort by Messages desc

content.json: Identify and classify email sending sources. Investigate authorized vs suspicious senders, detect volume anomalies, explore geographic distribution, and discover new source IPs appearing in your DMARC reports.

### Sender Classification
- **Authorized**: passes DMARC (95%+), so it authenticates with your domain.
- **Forwarded / Indirect**: fails mostly because of forwarding or mailing lists, as reported by the receiver.
- **Needs Attention**: passes some of the time.
- **Misconfigured**: a recognized email provider that mostly fails. Either your service is missing DKIM or return-path setup, or someone else is using the same provider to send as your domain.
- **Unknown / Suspicious**: an unrecognized source that mostly fails. This is likely spoofing.

Providers are recognized from the SPF (return-path) domain, which the sender controls, so treat the provider name as a hint rather than proof.

content.json: Track per-domain compliance scores, plan your DMARC policy progression from p=none to p=reject, monitor DKIM selector rotation, detect potential spoofing.

### Compliance Scoring
Each domain receives a **Compliance Score** (0–100) based on a weighted formula:

`Score = 0.40 × DMARC Pass Rate + 0.25 × SPF Pass Rate + 0.25 × DKIM Pass Rate + 0.10 × Policy Score`

**Policy Score:** `p=reject` = 100 · `p=quarantine` = 60 · `p=none` = 20

The score rewards domains that have **both** SPF and DKIM properly configured (defense-in-depth) and are enforcing their DMARC policy. A domain relying on only one mechanism or still using `p=none` will score lower even with a high overall DMARC pass rate.

**Risk Levels:** Low (90+) · Moderate (70–89) · High (50–69) · Critical (<50)

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend MessageCountSafe = tolong(coalesce(MessageCount, 0))
;
let policies = data
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PolicyPublished_p, PolicyPublished_sp) by Domain
| project Domain, PolicyPublished_p, PolicyPublished_sp;
data
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| summarize
    Messages = sum(MessageCountSafe),
    DmarcPass = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == true),
    DmarcFail = sumif(MessageCountSafe, DmarcPassEffective == false),
    SpfPassCount = sumif(MessageCountSafe, PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass'),
    DkimPassCount = sumif(MessageCountSafe, PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass'),
    UniqueIPs = dcountif(SourceIP, isnotempty(SourceIP)),
    SuspiciousIPs = dcountif(SourceIP, DmarcPassEffective == false)
    by Domain
| join kind=leftouter policies on Domain
| extend
    PassRate = iff(Messages > 0, round(100.0 * DmarcPass / Messages, 1), 0.0),
    SpfPassRate = iff(Messages > 0, round(100.0 * SpfPassCount / Messages, 1), 0.0),
    DkimPassRate = iff(Messages > 0, round(100.0 * DkimPassCount / Messages, 1), 0.0),
    ComplianceScore = iff(
        Messages > 0,
        round(
            0.40 * (100.0 * DmarcPass / Messages)
            + 0.25 * (100.0 * SpfPassCount / Messages)
            + 0.25 * (100.0 * DkimPassCount / Messages)
            + 0.10 * case(PolicyPublished_p == 'reject', 100.0, PolicyPublished_p == 'quarantine', 60.0, PolicyPublished_p == 'none', 20.0, 0.0)
        , 0),
        0.0
    )
| extend
    RiskLevel = case(
        ComplianceScore >= 90, 'Low',
        ComplianceScore >= 70, 'Moderate',
        ComplianceScore >= 50, 'High',
        'Critical'
    )
| project Domain, ComplianceScore, RiskLevel, PassRate, SpfPassRate, DkimPassRate,
    Policy=PolicyPublished_p, SubdomainPolicy=PolicyPublished_sp,
    Messages, UniqueIPs, SuspiciousIPs
| sort by ComplianceScore asc

content.json:
### Policy Progression

**Column guide:**
- **PassRate** — percentage of messages where SPF or DKIM passed DMARC alignment
- **AdjustedPassRate** — PassRate but counting forwarding overrides (forwarded, mailing list, trusted forwarder) as passes, since these are expected failures, not real threats
- **ForwardingOverrides** — messages that failed DMARC but were flagged by the receiver as forwarded/mailing list mail
- **DaysWithData** — number of distinct days with report data in the last 30 days (more days = higher confidence in the recommendation)
- **SuspiciousIPs** — unique source IPs where the message did not pass DMARC (neither SPF nor DKIM passed alignment)

    Messages = sum(MessageCount),

    UniqueIPs = dcount(SourceIP),
    SuspiciousIPs = dcountif(SourceIP, DmarcPassEffective == false),
    ForwardingOverrides = sumif(MessageCount, PolicyEvaluated_reason_type has_any ('forwarded', 'mailing_list', 'trusted_forwarder')),
    DaysWithData = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)),

content.json:
### DMARC Policy Progression Guidance

**Moving from Monitor to Enforcement:**

- **Current Policy: `p=none` (Monitor Mode)**
  - Safe to move to `p=quarantine` if:
    - **Adjusted pass rate ≥97%** for at least **14 days** with data (see Domain Readiness table — adjusted rate counts forwarding overrides as passes)
    - All legitimate mail sources are authenticated (review Top Source IPs)
    - No business-critical senders are failing authentication
  - Action: Review suspicious IPs and subdomain discovery before progressing

- **Current Policy: `p=quarantine` (Quarantine Mode)**
  - Safe to move to `p=reject` if:
    - **Adjusted pass rate ≥99%** for at least **14 days** with data (see Domain Readiness table)
    - Zero complaints from users about legitimate mail in spam/quarantine
    - All critical business workflows tested and verified
  - Action: Move to `p=reject` once the criteria above are met. Don't rely on `pct=` for a gradual rollout: DMARCbis drops it and receivers apply partial values inconsistently.

- **Current Policy: `p=reject` (Reject Mode)**
  - You've achieved full DMARC enforcement!
  - Continue monitoring for new legitimate sources and authentication failures
  - Ensure subdomain policy (`sp=`) is also set appropriately

**Best Practices:**
- Monitor for at least 7-14 days after any policy change
- Always verify legitimate mail providers are authenticated before enforcing
- Set up Azure Monitor alerts for authentication failure spikes

### Azure Monitor Alert Rule Templates

Create alert rules in Azure Monitor using these KQL queries to get notified about DMARC issues. Navigate to **Azure Monitor > Alerts > Create alert rule** and select your Log Analytics workspace.

**1. DMARC Pass Rate Drop Alert** (run every 1 hour, look back 24 hours):
```kql
DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| summarize Pass = sumif(MessageCount, DmarcPassEffective == true), Total = sum(MessageCount)
| extend PassRate = 100.0 * Pass / Total
| where PassRate < 90
```

**2. New Suspicious Source IP Alert** (run every 6 hours):
```kql
let known = DMARCReports_CL | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d)) | distinct SourceIP;
DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where SourceIP !in (known)
| extend DmarcPassEffective = coalesce(tobool(column_ifexists('DmarcPass', bool(null))), PolicyEvaluated_dkim =~ 'pass' or PolicyEvaluated_spf =~ 'pass')
| where DmarcPassEffective == false
| summarize FailedMessages = sum(MessageCount), Domains = make_set(Domain) by SourceIP
| where FailedMessages >= 10
```

**3. Volume Spike Alert** (run every 1 hour):
```kql
let baseline = DMARCReports_CL | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d)) | summarize AvgDaily = sum(MessageCount) / 29.0;
let recent = DMARCReports_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize RecentTotal = sum(MessageCount);
baseline | extend x = 1 | join kind=inner (recent | extend x = 1) on x
| where RecentTotal > AvgDaily * 3
```

**4. Stale Reporters Alert** (run every 12 hours):
```kql
let historical = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(3d))
| summarize HistoricalMessages = sum(MessageCount) by ReportOrgName;
let recent = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
| distinct ReportOrgName;
historical
| where HistoricalMessages >= 50
| where ReportOrgName !in (recent)
| summarize StaleReporterCount = count()
| where StaleReporterCount > 0
```

**5. Duplicate Report-Key Ratio Alert** (run every 6 hours):
```kql
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)
| extend
    DuplicateKey = tostring(column_ifexists('DuplicateTelemetryKey', '')),
    SourceMessageIdSafe = tostring(column_ifexists('SourceMessageId', '')),
    IngestionRunIdSafe = tostring(column_ifexists('IngestionRunId', ''))
| where isnotempty(DuplicateKey)
| extend HasRunMetadata = isnotempty(SourceMessageIdSafe) and isnotempty(IngestionRunIdSafe);
let coverage = data
| summarize
    ReportKeysObserved = dcount(DuplicateKey),
    KeysWithRunMetadata = dcountif(DuplicateKey, HasRunMetadata)
| extend DuplicateMetadataCoverage = iff(ReportKeysObserved > 0, round(100.0 * KeysWithRunMetadata / ReportKeysObserved, 2), 0.0);
let duplicates = data
| where HasRunMetadata
| summarize DistinctRuns = dcount(strcat(SourceMessageIdSafe, '|', IngestionRunIdSafe)) by DuplicateKey
| summarize TotalKeys = count(), DuplicateKeys = countif(DistinctRuns > 1)
| extend DuplicateRatio = iff(TotalKeys > 0, round(100.0 * DuplicateKeys / TotalKeys, 2), 0.0);
coverage
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=inner (duplicates | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| project-away JoinKey*
| where KeysWithRunMetadata >= 10 and DuplicateMetadataCoverage >= 80 and DuplicateRatio >= 5
```

**Tip:** Set up Action Groups to notify via Email, Teams, Slack (webhook), or trigger a Logic App for automated responses.

content.json: ### Function Runtime Health

### Runtime Triage
- If other apps send telemetry to this workspace, set **Function App name** above. Otherwise only the DMARC function names are matched.
- Correlate FailedExecutions and FailureRatePct with DMARCReports_CL ingestion volume for the same time range.
- If failures rise while ingestion volume stays stable, it's usually transient parsing noise. Monitor for recovery.
- If failures rise and ingestion volume drops, the pipeline is degraded. Check Graph subscription expiry and Event Grid delivery and dead-letter health, then run CatchupProcessor to recover unread reports.
- "Could not extract message ID from Event Grid event" is a parsing issue in the function code. No data is lost: Graph retries delivery and CatchupProcessor recovers anything missed. Note the error text, function name and timestamp, and [open an issue](https://github.com/pthoor/DMARC-for-Defender-XDR/issues).
- Use LastSeen to spot stalled jobs: RenewGraphSubscription should run on schedule, CatchupProcessor daily, and DmarcReportProcessor when reports arrive.
- Full procedure: [Runbook - Function failures or runtime regressions](https://github.com/pthoor/DMARC-for-Defender-XDR/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#scenario-function-failures-or-runtime-regressions).

### Duplicate Suppression Telemetry
Shows whether the same report was ingested more than once. Older records may not include the duplicate metadata (DuplicateTelemetryKey, SourceMessageId, IngestionRunId). Ratios are computed only from keys with complete metadata, and the coverage is shown so you can judge how reliable they are.

content.query:
let domainFilter = dynamic([{Domain}]);
let reporterFilter = dynamic([{Reporter}]);
let data = DMARCReports_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in (domainFilter) or Domain in (domainFilter)
| where '*' in (reporterFilter) or ReportOrgName in (reporterFilter)
| extend
    DuplicateKey = tostring(column_ifexists('DuplicateTelemetryKey', '')),
    SourceMessageIdSafe = tostring(column_ifexists('SourceMessageId', '')),
    IngestionRunIdSafe = tostring(column_ifexists('IngestionRunId', ''))
| where isnotempty(DuplicateKey)
| extend HasRunMetadata = isnotempty(SourceMessageIdSafe) and isnotempty(IngestionRunIdSafe);
let coveragePerDay = data
| summarize
    TotalKeysObserved = dcount(DuplicateKey),
    KeysWithRunMetadata = dcountif(DuplicateKey, HasRunMetadata)
    by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend DuplicateMetadataCoverage = iff(TotalKeysObserved > 0, round(100.0 * KeysWithRunMetadata / TotalKeysObserved, 2), 0.0);
let perKeyPerDay = data
| where HasRunMetadata
| summarize DistinctRuns = dcount(strcat(SourceMessageIdSafe, '|', IngestionRunIdSafe)) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DuplicateKey;
let duplicatePerDay = perKeyPerDay
| summarize
    TotalKeys = count(),
    DuplicateKeys = countif(DistinctRuns > 1)
    by Day
| extend DuplicateRatio = iff(TotalKeys > 0, round(100.0 * DuplicateKeys / TotalKeys, 2), 0.0);
coveragePerDay
| join kind=leftouter duplicatePerDay on Day
| extend
    TotalKeys = tolong(coalesce(TotalKeys, 0)),
    DuplicateKeys = tolong(coalesce(DuplicateKeys, 0)),
    DuplicateRatio = todouble(coalesce(DuplicateRatio, 0.0))
| project TimeGenerated = Day, DuplicateRatio, DuplicateKeys, TotalKeys, DuplicateMetadataCoverage, KeysWithRunMetadata, TotalKeysObserved
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
